SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts p JOIN post_categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE p.status = 'ACTIVE'
AND c.code = #{categoryCode}
mapper.sql: SELECT p.id, p.member_id, c.code AS category_code, c.name AS category_name, p.title, p.like_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments cm WHERE cm.post_id = p.id AND cm.status = 'ACTIVE') AS comment_count, p.created_at FROM posts p JOIN post_categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE p.status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: ORDER BY p.like_count DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.id, p.member_id, c.code AS category_code, c.name AS category_name, p.title, p.content, p.view_count, p.like_count, p.status, p.created_at FROM posts p JOIN post_categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE p.id = #{postId}
SELECT id, member_id, parent_comment_id, content, status, created_at FROM comments WHERE post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY COALESCE(parent_comment_id, id), id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post_reports (post_id, reporter_id, reason) VALUES (#{postId}, #{reporterId}, #{reason})
mapper.select: SELECT id, reporter_id, reason, status, created_at FROM post_reports WHERE post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY id DESC
